COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im.
   C. Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im as rumours only.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea.
   C. Say Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

5. Which statement about Negotiation Skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Negotiation Skills.
   B. Explain Negotiation Skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Negotiation Skills never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Negotiation Skills as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.
   B. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   D. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Advocacy in the School Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Advocacy in the School Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Advocacy in the School Community as rumours only.
   C. Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the School Community.

8. Which statement about Building Consensus is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Building Consensus as rumours only.
   B. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus.
   D. Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Intercultural Competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Intercultural Competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence.
   C. Treat Intercultural Competence as rumours only.
   D. Say Intercultural Competence never happens in Kenya.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr.
   C. Explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. as rumours only.
   B. Say Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2..

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Intercultural Competence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nurturing Empathy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
